meet_neighbor: Visit the neighbor's house, go upstairs, and inspect the item on the floor so the rival appears.
The male player is Brendan and the rival is May; the female player is May and the rival is Brendan.
rescue_birch: After meeting the rival, leave Littleroot to the north and reach Route 101 for Birch's rescue.
Choose a starter from Birch's bag during the rescue encounter.
reach_rival: After Birch's lab scene, cross Route 101 and Oldale Town to reach the rival on Route 103.
receive_pokedex: Return route: Route 103 -> SOUTH to Oldale -> SOUTH to Route 101 -> SOUTH to Littleroot -> Professor Birch's Lab. When already on Route 101, Oldale is NORTH behind you; continue SOUTH toward Birch.
Speak with Professor Birch and the rival to receive the Pokedex and Poke Balls. The rival victory is a milestone, not the end of the first-gym mission.
visit_petalburg: Travel NORTH from Littleroot through Route 101 to Oldale, then WEST through Route 102 to Petalburg City. On Route 101, Littleroot is SOUTH behind you; Oldale is NORTH ahead.
Enter Petalburg Gym and talk to Norman near its entrance to begin Wally's catching tutorial. This is a story visit, not your first gym battle.
After the tutorial returns to the gym, finish Norman's dialogue. Then travel west to Route 104.
cross_woods: From Petalburg City travel west to Route 104, then enter Petalburg Woods in the north of the southern route section.
Walk through the woods, help the Devon employee against Team Aqua and continue north. Normal trainer and wild battles provide experience.
Heal at Petalburg before the journey if badly injured. Use supplies or return to a center when necessary.
first_gym: Leave Petalburg Woods through the north exit, then follow northern Route 104 and its bridge to Rustboro City. Different Route 104 exits reach different parts of the same map.
Roxanne leads Rustboro Gym and uses Rock-type Pokemon. Water and Grass moves are useful; consult the Pokemon reference for your party's moves and evolutions.
Heal at Rustboro's Pokemon Center before challenging the gym. Fight available trainers or wild Pokemon to prepare; do not repeatedly rematch with an exhausted or underprepared party.
Choose whether to train, catch a useful teammate or buy healing supplies. Inside the gym, navigate around obstacles and talk to trainers and Roxanne. Earning the Stone Badge completes this mission.
